answer:
Helm stores release data in Secret.Data map. ArgoCD stores cluster credentials, repository credentials, and settings in Secret.Data fields. Cert-manager reads/writes TLS certificates, keys, Vault credentials, DNS provider credentials, and Venafi credentials from Secret.Data. External-secrets pushsecret controller reads Secret.Data to push secret values to external providers.

## Affected Files

| Repo | File | Why |
|------|------|-----|
| helm | `pkg/storage/driver/secrets.go` | Stores release data in Secret.Data map, encoding release metadata as base64 byte values |
| argo-cd | `util/db/secrets.go` | Stores and reads cluster/repo credentials from Secret.Data |
| argo-cd | `util/db/repository_secrets.go` | Repository credentials stored in Secret.Data |
| argo-cd | `util/db/cluster.go` | Cluster connection data stored in Secret.Data |
| argo-cd | `util/settings/settings.go` | Settings stored in Secret.Data fields |
| cert-manager | `pkg/controller/certificates/issuing/internal/secret.go` | Reads/writes TLS certificates and keys to Secret.Data |
| cert-manager | `pkg/controller/cainjector/sources.go` | CA injector reads certificate data from Secret.Data |
| cert-manager | `internal/vault/vault.go` | Reads CA certs, TLS certs, private keys, and AppRole credentials from secret.Data[key] for Vault issuer authentication |
| cert-manager | `pkg/issuer/acme/dns/dns.go` | Reads DNS provider credentials (CloudDNS, Cloudflare, Route53, AzureDNS) from saSecret.Data[key] |
| cert-manager | `pkg/issuer/venafi/client/venaficlient.go` | Reads Venafi TPP username/password/accessToken and Cloud API key from tppSecret.Data[key] |
| external-secrets | `pkg/controllers/pushsecret/pushsecret_controller.go` | Reads secret.Data[key] to check key existence and push secret values to external providers |
